about: Consistency audit v2 — the rules check's exceptions. Each entry names a rule, the pages it covers ("*" for all, or a key prefix ending in *), what it matches (sel: a class or selector fragment found in the element's selector or ancestry; text: a case-insensitive pattern on its text; detail: a pattern on the reading), and why it is allowed. An entry without a reason stops the check. Seeded from what the roll-out reports recorded as left, skipped or in flight; rules-result.json lists every entry that matched nothing on a run. Roll-out v2 (rulings v3): stale entries removed, the agreed exceptions and everything the run left added, each with its reason. Every entry has a kind: agreed (a ruling or a baked decision), in-flight (another session's file) or open (left, reverted or untraced); consolidate-and-finish v1.
